RISK 2: the DCP nycmih/nyih layers carry a 'not for tax-lot-level eligibility' disclaimer and the Appendix F CD 11 map image (the legal instrument) is not transcribed. The membership fact is robust (5,925 ft / 17,618 ft margins, ~300x map tolerance) so research_status answered_from_primary_source stands, but requested_label is Provisional with non-empty conditions; nothing Verified.

RISK 3: MapPLUTO release not stamped in live metadata (independent check read 26v2). E1 document_date carries the caveat and freshness.limitation records it; the OUT margins make the conclusion release-robust.

RISK 4: the downstream reading (UAP route; 23-22/23-432 columns not gated by MIH) is interpretation, not a settled fact; it stays unreviewed draft and conditional; option 2 case rows may cite NB-07 but this task computes no value and wires no connector.
